question: A garden hose is spraying water almost straight up into the air. The end of the hose where the water exits is at elevation $134.5 \text{ m}$ . The hose is $2 \text{ cm}$ in diameter, and the flow rate is $2 \text{ L/s}$. What is the hydraulic head h in the water right as it exits the hose? Assuming that the water has this same $h$ as it travels up and down in the air, what would be the highest elevation that the water arc reaches? Assume $v=0$ at the top of the arc. Give your answer in m and two decimal places
